title: schema-generator: build Organization, Product and FAQPage JSON-LD in the browser
description:
Builds valid schema.org JSON-LD for the three types that matter most to SaaS and developer-tool sites: Organization, Product/SoftwareApplication and FAQPage. Light validation, then a ready-to-paste <script> block.

Runs entirely in the browser. A single static page — index.html plus app.js — with no build step, no dependencies and no server. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.

Structured data is published here for machine-readability and general good practice. We make no claim that it increases the likelihood of citation by an AI answer engine — the one controlled study on that question found a null result once ranking position was controlled for.
